Pleasantly Surprised!. I admit I have never tried a sound app such as this before, but finding this I didn’t need to! It is literally everything I was looking for, it has a timer, you can combine noises, make your own mix of sounds to save, keeps playing when your phone is off, and overall is just an easily navigable app! It does have a premium feature available, but it doesn’t lock everything behind a paywall which I love! I was very pleasantly surprised with this app and plan to continue using it for a long time!

Everything you’d ever need to feel relaxed. I have a white noise machine that I use at home and had left to travel to New York to visit family and did not take the sound machine with me and I began searching for something to replace that comfort of white noise and I found this app! I tried the free trial and fell in love. You can combine sounds to make what is perfect for you and the options are ENDLESS, so many great sounds. 10/10 recommend.
